g.text: PR #2395 · Move generated Codex images into archived Portal media
Generated images leave the inline transcript and enter the authenticated media archive.
Portal references stay distinct from provider file IDs; upload failures remain recoverable.
BEFORE
AFTER
ImageGeneration.result contains base64
Classifier serializes the original image string.
Output buffers and transcript rows retain its bytes.
GeneratedMediaNormalizer::normalize
Takes the source string before await/serialization.
Decode and upload are capped at 10 MiB.
Status card has no Portal media reference
A provider fileId is not an authenticated image URL.
The generation card cannot supply the image.
POST /api/agent/sessions/{id}/media
Existing authenticated upload persists media message.
portalMedia carries the Portal-owned image UUID.
No transfer or recovery outcome on the card
Inline data stays in the transcript.
Image status alone cannot explain upload failure.
Failure is visible and recovery is bounded
Native saved path or private recovery file.
32 files, 64 MiB total, 24h TTL; filesystem lock.
Provider-only file IDs retain their original meaning.
Lifecycle repeats reuse small per-turn references.
Old upload responses still decode without media_id.
HTTP and recovery-budget regressions are covered.
Limits: provider-only fileId needs local bytes; failed uploads need manual recovery before the temporary spool expires.
